cgtDiscountReplacement.value: For resident individuals and trusts, cost-base indexation (s 110-36(1A)) applies to CGT events on or after 1 July 2027 and the 30% minimum tax (Division 119, resident individuals) applies. The 50% discount remains for individuals on CGT events before 1 July 2027 and, on later events, for new residential dwellings (s 115-102). Assets held on 30 June 2027 can be treated as sold and bought back on 1 July 2027, so only growth from that date is indexed.
